summary: Full e2e of admin community management (Fase 1). Backend: 22/22 pytest PASS covering authz (7 non-admin→403), users list w/ counts+fields, ?q= filter, user detail (+404), courtesy plus on/off (verified via /plus/status), creations list, invalid/missing delete codes (400/404), and cascade deletes using THROWAWAY docs — pet cascade removes memories+stories+portraits+videos (user intact); user cascade removes pets/memories/stories/portraits/videos/subscriptions/sessions; individual creation deletes don't affect siblings. Frontend (mobile 390x844): admin sees 3 tabs, Resumen renders 4 KPIs+survey, Usuarios lists 2 users with search filter working (q='eduardo' hides norm user), user detail shows toggle-plus/pets/creations/del-user (danger zone), Plus courtesy toggle flips badge Dar↔Quitar via admin API, admin-user detail hides del-user, Creaciones tab lists 57 items with two-step ConfirmButton (admin-del-gcreation-{id} → -confirm). Non-admin at /admin shows admin-unauthorized screen. DB left clean: no subscriptions on user_testnorm1/user_testadmin1, no throwaway docs remain, Rocco pet intact.
critical_code_review_comments: _delete_pet_cascade: slides deletion queries db.stories AFTER db.stories.delete_many for that pet — but it runs BEFORE in current code order. Actually re-read: stories.delete_many(pet_id) happens first then slides.delete_many using db.stories.find(pet_id) which is now empty. This means slides for deleted stories are NEVER deleted → orphan slides remain in DB after pet cascade. Impact: data bloat, not user-visible. Suggested fix: capture story_ids BEFORE deleting stories (same pattern used in admin_delete_user, lines 1452–1453). Priority: MEDIUM.
admin_set_plus does not validate body shape; body.get('active') with no body returns truthy=None (falsy) silently deactivating. Minor — consider pydantic model.
AdminUsers.jsx + Admin.jsx duplicate ConfirmButton; could be lifted to a shared component in /components.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users/pets/memories/stories/portraits/videos/subscriptions/sessions created per cascade test with uuid-based ids, all deleted in fixture teardown. Final-state assertion verifies real fixtures intact & no leftover courtesy subscriptions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin community panel fully verified. Backend regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_admin_community.py (22 tests, ~4s) covers all 7 admin endpoints + cascades. Only RCA finding: _delete_pet_cascade leaks slides (orders delete_many before fetching story_ids). Suggest main agent fix slide-orphan bug by reordering as in admin_delete_user.
rca of the issue: Potential orphan slides on pet cascade — server.py line 1433-1434: stories.delete_many(pet_id=X) runs BEFORE slides.delete_many using db.stories.find(pet_id=X) which post-delete returns [], so slides are never deleted. Reproduce: insert story with slides for a pet, DELETE /api/admin/pets/{pet_id}, then query db.slides.find({story_id: <that story's id>}) → still present. Mitigation: snapshot story_ids first, delete slides, then delete stories (mirror admin_delete_user).
